svg.title: Zangbundel - leader mode (kampvuurleider), from preparation to the end of the campfire

g.text: Zangbundel - leader mode (kampvuurleider), from preparation to the end of the campfire
guiDesign.md v0.8 · ble-protocol.md v0.12 · FRD v0.10
read persisted gathering (key, gid, name, tokens, seq)
[crashed while leading, within the resume window (default 10 min) [FR-GATH-13, 10.9]]
instead of the welcome screen: name, fingerprint, time since the crash,
pre-start scan ignoring this gid; restart beacon, data sets, GATT server;
beacon with the same gid → singers reconnect by themselves [FR-GATH-10]
the leader's page as it was (continue at section 6)
delete resume data, keys and singer table [FR-DATA-08]
resume data older than the window → delete [FR-DATA-08]
welcome screen: name + versionName, at most 1.5 s [D-04, D-05]
home screen: scanning; "Zelf een kampvuur starten",
icon row: Bibliotheek · Setlists · Herinneringen · Instellingen · Over [D-21, D-22]
[online: URL of a repository, release index or .zbl archive]
archive bytes (checked against sha256 from the index)
[from a file (.zbl or zip from storage, share sheet, SD card) [FR-LIB-16]]
bound the input, read the manifest, verify every song hash,
validate as section 11; library id clash → refuse (L006) [song-format 12.7]
install atomically; record revision, version, source [FR-LIB-15, FR-LIB-17]
assign the next library colour (8 colour-blind-safe colours) [D-51]
import report: imported · skipped (file, reason) · warnings [FR-LIB-07]
fetch newer release (only on tap, or a Wi-Fi check that asks first) [FR-LIB-12, FR-LIB-13]
"wat is er veranderd": added, changed, removed [FR-LIB-11]
combined list of enabled libraries: colour square, title, language,
usage "3× · laatst 12 okt"; library name added when a title occurs twice [D-51, D-52]
search a word in the title (switch "ook in de tekst"), sort A-Z / Z-A /
vaakst / laatst gezongen, chips library · language · tag · usage
filtered list; "Wis filters" visible while anything is filtered [D-52]
lyric view (day theme outside a gathering), song info available;
[new, rename, duplicate or delete (delete is confirmed)]
[import a .zbs from a file or URL [D-59]]
parse (song-format 13), resolve entries against installed libraries
import report; unresolved entries kept as "niet gevonden" with the reason [D-74]
songbook in editing mode: banner "Zomerkamp · 14 liederen",
a checkbox before every row (title, language, library colour and name) [D-54]
tick / untick songs; drag to reorder, swipe to remove; "Klaar"
.zbs file through the share sheet (mail, messenger, files) [D-59]
gathering settings: neutral name proposed ("Kampvuur 20 okt"), join code or
QR-only, setlist to start with [D-25, FR-GATH-01, FR-GATH-05, FR-GATH-21]
"Zet de batterijbespaarstand uit en gebruik een powerbank" (starting still allowed) [D-68]
listen ≥ 5 s for running gatherings (the home screen has been scanning already) [D-23, FR-GATH-16]
refuse: its name and "Meezingen" instead; no override [FR-GATH-16]
Ed25519 key pair, gid = SHA-256(pk)[0..5]; X25519 key ek;
seq random, ts 0; copy the setlist into the gathering [10.1, D-55]
persist key, gid, name, code, seq, singer table (resume data) [FR-GATH-13]
GATT server; beacon (connectable, high power); legacy data sets
until refused (≤ 3); extended set if supported; carousel [6, 7.1, 7.4]
beacon {gid, seq, flags, name} and carousel: state, info, setlist
leader's page: leader bar "Kampvuur 20 okt · appel-vuur · 0 zangers · 0:00",
setlist block, every song below its separator, unresolved ones greyed with
the reason; buttons ▲ · ≡ · ▼ and the QR button; night theme [D-55, D-56, D-57, D-61, D-74]
connect; write Join (sealed to ek): sid, name, code, xk [9.3]
open, check code and capacity; store sid, xk; count
Join response sealed to xk: result, token
leader bar "· 12 zangers"; live statistics: singers now, evening maximum [D-61, D-62]
The leader never sees a list of singers: only the count (D-73).
Display names appear only on requests (D-63).
7. Showing the join QR code, at any time
QR code black on a white panel, brightness raised; name, fingerprint,
join code as text unless QR-only [FR-GATH-19, FR-DIST-02]
a singer scans it with the camera app → joins as in section 6
tap anywhere → page again, brightness restored
The join code and QR-only are fixed for this gathering;
a change means ending and starting a new one (D-71).
scroll; ▲ / ▼ move between separators on the leader's own page only [D-57]
song document (DEFLATE, framed); state: cur, title, seq + 1, ts ↑; sign [9.5, 10.5]
beacon seq within 100 ms; burst: state first, then 3 passes of the song [6.4, 7.4]
singers with the library use their own file; others collect the frames;
missing frames are repaired over GATT [10.3, 10.4]
separator "wordt gezongen", previous "gezongen", setlist block updated;
live statistics: songs sung, duration of the previous song [D-56, D-62]
songs in between stay in the list, unmarked (skipped) [FR-LEAD-03]
re-push: seq + 1, 3 more passes; singers that have it do nothing [FR-LEAD-06, 10.5]
[language button on the bar (only when another language variant exists) [D-65]]
the bar shows the variant (e.g. "EN"); "Nu" then pushes the variant [FR-LEAD-07]
header strip "gewist"; text stays on the singers' screens
The leader marks no line or verse: follow-the-leader follows song starts only (D-70).
Unresolved setlist entries have no "Nu"; ▲ / ▼ step over them (D-74).
9. Changing the setlist during the campfire
add after the current song, or push at once (as section 8)
setlist document changed, seq + 1, sign; burst [9.5, 10.5]
new setlist; singers still see only songs already pushed [D-47]
write Request 0007 (sealed): token, rid, song ref or free text ≤ 100 [9.6]
store as pending; group identical songs, count likes [FR-LEAD-12, D-32]
rseq + 1, seq + 1, reqstat with the pending rid; sign; burst [9.4, 9.5]
badge on the leader bar: rows not yet handled [D-61, D-63]
error 0x81 "requests are closed"; singers' request buttons disabled [8.3]
one row per song: title (free text in italics), library colour,
count "×4", time, requesters "Jip, Noor en 2 anderen" [D-63, FR-LEAD-10]
append after the current song; status accepted with setlist position
push at once (as section 8); status sung
every requester learns the outcome from reqstat, anonymously [FR-REQ-05]
beacon and state flag REQ_OPEN = 0; document 8 open = false [6.1, 9.5]
assistentcode: 4 random digits, valid 120 s, one at a time [10.12]
reads the code to the helper standing next to the leader
Control op 9 {token, cid, hc} sealed to ek [9.8]
add the helper's sid to dlg; consume the code; seq + 1; sign; burst
state with own sid in dlg → tab "Leiden"; fetch document 8 (sealed) [D-46]
0x8E; the leader shows a new code if needed [8.3]
[the assistent acts (accept / decline / push a request, push or add a song)]
apply as if on the leader's screen; seq + 1; sign; burst [FR-LEAD-43]
the leader's page and request list update as it happens [FR-LEAD-45]
remove sid from dlg; seq + 1; sign; burst [10.12]
12. The leader bar during the campfire
drag the handle on the leader bar, or tap it [D-61]
drawer: time since start · songs sung · singers now (max) · link quality
"goed / matig / zwak" · duration of the last song; rows Verzoeken · Assistenten ·
Deelnamecode · Statistieken delen · Kampvuur beëindigen [D-61, D-62]
every 30 s a 2 s scan for other gatherings [10.1, FR-GATH-17]
drawer row "Ander kampvuur in de buurt: '<name>'" (information only, no alert) [D-68]
[battery saver switched on, or the platform is about to stop the beacon [FR-GATH-15]]
warning icon on the leader bar; nothing interrupts [D-68]
record: song identifiers, relative push time, duration, skipped;
singer counts; BLE repair and failure figures; versions (no names, no ids)
swipe up, tap the lyrics, or "Nu" → drawer closes
remove sid (and from dlg); invalidate token; singers − 1; seq + 1; sign
no GATT activity for 10 min → removed from the count [10.9]
[the closing bar at the end of the setlist [D-69]]
"Afsluiten" on the bar "Einde van de setlist"
state status = 1, ENDED flag, seq + 1; sign [10.10]
beacon ENDED; burst of the final state; notify stay connections
singers show "beëindigd", delete received songs, write their memory [10.11, D-49]
summary screen: name, date, time sung, songs sung, maximum singers;
leader's gathering memory: name, date, participant count, titles sung;
discard requests, the gathering's setlist copy, connection data [FR-DATA-03, FR-DATA-06]
stop beacon, data sets, extended set and GATT server [10.10]
delete keys (pk, sk, ek), singer table, tokens, resume data [FR-DATA-08]
JSON or CSV through the share sheet (mail, WhatsApp, Signal, files);
the app has no server and sends nothing itself
Not in phase 1, by decision: no download instruction for singers (D-66, FR-LEAD-30 withdrawn), no singer list (D-73),
no hand-over of the leader role, stop and restart instead (D-72), no change of the join code during a gathering (D-71),
